nit: for consistency with other helpers, could we pack the version string via PackBuffer instead of std::memcpy + hardcoded offset 12?
The test name says "RemovesInterface" but SUCCEED() doesn't verify removal. Could we add EXPECT_THROW(getProperty<...>(path, ...), sdbusplus::exception_t) after the scope exit?

nit: other test files use `NvidiaXxxTestBase` (e.g. NvidiaGpuPowerSensorTestBase). Could we rename this to NvidiaGpuDeviceTestBase for consistency? 
Same for SmaDevice / PcieDevice.
nit: this drain pattern is duplicated across NvidiaGpu/Sma/Pcie Device tests — could become a DbusMockTestBase::drainPendingAsync() helper.
defaultEid / errorResponseSize / response-size literals are duplicated across 10+ test files. Could we put them into a shared utils/TestConstants.hpp and derive sizes from commonResponseSize?
The buildXxxResponse pattern is repeated near-identically across most test files. Could it be extracted to a shared utils/TestResponseBuilders.hpp?
nit: use the enum (e.g. PlatformEnvironmentalCommands::GET_CURRENT_POWER_DRAW) for consistency with test_NvidiaGpuControl.cpp.
Could we put in utils/TestResponseBuilders.hpp? (Same as Line 33)

Thanks for adding these case.
Could we add UpdateMctpTransportError and UpdateSuccessThenErrorKeepsPreviousValue tests here (and in test_NvidiaGpuMemoryClockFrequency.cpp) following the pattern in
test_NvidiaGpuSensor.cpp L278 / L316?
